gloss: by the end of today; within today

definitions.gloss: by the end of today; within today; before today is over
definitions.explanation: A time expression meaning before today ends. Used to set a deadline for the current day.

examples.japanese: {今日中|きょうじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll finish it by the end of today.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{今日中|きょうじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit this report by the end of today.

examples.japanese: {今日中|きょうじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm not sure if I can get a reply by the end of today.

notes:
A deadline expression meaning "before today ends." It sets the current day as the time limit for completing something, and is common in workplace instructions and promises.

PATTERN: ～{中|じゅう}
The suffix ～{中|じゅう} means "within" or "by the end of" a time period:
- {今日中|きょうじゅう} — by the end of today
- {今週中|こんしゅうじゅう} — within this week
- {今月中|こんげつじゅう} — within this month
- ⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧ — during the morning (note: this uses ちゅう)

PRONUNCIATION:
Read as きょうじゅう (not きょうちゅう). The ～{中|じゅう} reading emphasizes the deadline sense ("by the end of"), while ～⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ emphasizes duration ("throughout").
